# Wiki index

<!-- generated by `pnpm wiki:index` — do not edit; `pnpm wiki:check` enforces sync -->

- [Acceptance routing](acceptance-routing.md) — Who gets asked to accept a lane, why it is nearly always the same seat, and how to measure any of it without fooling yourself.
- [Amending an ADR](amending-an-adr.md) — Only an accepted ADR's `## Decision` is frozen — a dated follow-up note in `## Consequences` is the PRESCRIBED amendment mechanism, and a superseding ADR is for reversing a decision, not recording what happened next.
- [Archive — the harness-memory corpus, dispositioned](archive.md) — Where each remaining file of the pre-wiki harness memory corpus (88 files, migrated 2026-08-13 under ADR 259 increment 2) ended up — live knowledge became the pages in this wiki; everything below is superseded history or already recorded elsewhere, kept here as one dated ledger so nothing silently vanished.
- [The Twitch broadcast — topology and cost](broadcast-stream.md) — The stream rents one Fly machine per stream (its lifetime IS the stream's) reaching the loopback daemon over Tailscale; the whole cost is compute, not egress — and two plausible cost claims were measured dead.
- [Verifying web changes in the Browser pane](browser-verification.md) — The in-app Browser pane lies in three specific ways — a stale vite preview, a permanently hidden document, and React-batched clicks — and each one reads as "my change broke the page" when nothing is wrong.
- [A check that cannot separate two causes](cannot-separate-two-causes.md) — A check can run on schedule, read exactly the surface it was meant to read, and still be worthless — because two different causes produce the identical reading, and the check reports whichever one its author had in mind.
- [Standing-context byte budgets](context-budgets.md) — Every byte in the MCP tools/list render is paid by every seat on every turn — `pnpm context:check` gates it, and it is NOT in the usual local gate list, so run it before pushing any tool-surface change.
- [Controls in force](controls-in-force.md) — Every guard we believe is protecting us carries a date someone last watched it work — because an unexercised control is indistinguishable from a broken one.
- [Cookoff — the value experiment's standing rules and apparatus traps](cookoff.md) — The sell is D-vs-uncoordinated-N, NEVER D-vs-solo — flagship measured D vs C3 at the same 100 % correctness with 1.9 % vs 72.2 % wasted work (~38×), while solo A wins cost AND wall-clock (D burns ~7.7× solo's tokens), so A is the honest denominator and the cost objection is real.
- [Correct by coincidence](correct-by-coincidence.md) — A value that stands in for the truth stays right only while the two happen to agree — and the fixtures that would have shown the disagreement are usually the same ones that made it invisible.
- [Dependabot alerts can name packages the repo does not depend on](dependabot-alerts.md) — GitHub raises alerts from its own cached dependency graph, not from the lockfile in front of you, and that graph can lag by weeks — so triage starts by asking whether the package is even in `pnpm-lock.yaml` before anyone reads the advisory.
- [Feature epoch — the bump ritual](feature-epoch.md) — Bump `FEATURE_EPOCH` (packages/protocol/src/feature-epoch.ts) by 1 when a change gives the daemon or fresh seats a client-visible capability an older seat can't participate in or render — a new act, a new MCP tool, a roster-affecting field; NOT for bugfixes, refactors, or web-only tweaks.
- [Git safety — destructive commands that look like reads](git-safety.md) — `git checkout <file>` and `git reset --hard` both silently destroy uncommitted work with no reflog entry — commit or copy aside before any operation that restores or moves HEAD.
- [Instrument silence is not evidence](instrument-silence.md) — Before reading a quiet instrument as "nothing happened", make it observe a control event you cause yourself — most debugging time on this repo has gone to broken instruments, not broken systems.
- [Ledger seats](ledger-seats.md) — The three `kind = "service"` seats on the revive roster — what each one is for, why none of them can be woken or handed work, and where the autorefresh charter went when the roster could not carry it.
- [Measuring a moving page](measuring-a-moving-page.md) — Everything the contrast gate does — settle, freeze, screenshot, sample the pixel — is a race against anything the page is doing on a timer, and the traps below cost multiple lanes each before they were written down.
- [Model attestation — what a per-act model stamp is worth](model-attestation.md) — A stamp can be an observation or a declaration, the two are not distinguishable per act, and on this team a declaration that disagrees with the runtime is normal rather than broken — so `declared ≠ observed` is the wrong alarm and `nothing ever observed this seat` is the right one.
- [musterd CLI messaging from a shell](musterd-cli-messaging.md) — Never put backticks or `$()` in a `musterd send` body issued via a shell — command substitution runs even inside double quotes and splices the output into the sent message.
- [Name clearance — musterd domains and the trademark neighborhood](name-clearance.md) — musterd.io is the product's registered home as of 2026-08-13, the UK is the one jurisdiction with a true exact-mark blocker (Restranaut's registered MUSTERD in classes 9/42), and the US/EU registers are crowded-but-coexistent for the MUSTER/MUSTARD family — screening-grade findings, not legal clearance.
- [nick's laptop — constraints and load-bearing services](nicks-laptop.md) — The machine every seat shares is an 8 GB / 8-core MacBook that lives in swap — check `sysctl vm.swapusage` before any capture, probe, or many-process run, and never remove a service without checking `~/Library/LaunchAgents` first.
- [The office floor — layout invariants and how to change it](office-floor.md) — Any floor edit is bound by measured invariants (stand-behind clearance, nav-grid rounding, seat-assignment hashing) — the working method is a throwaway probe that prints the walkability map and every pairwise gap, never coordinate guessing.
- [The office scene — reference, ceilings, and layout traps](office-scene.md) — The /live isometric office derives from a specific Figma asset pack with a measured palette, and its hard constraint is scale: at office fit-scales the room's entire back wall is ~63–74px tall, so canvas type in the room is only viable for 2–3 glyphs.
- [Platform guardian](platform-guardian.md) — The pure-code on-call probe (ADR 263): what each incident class means, where its state lives, and how to operate it.
- [Positioning and brand architecture](positioning.md) — SandRise Studio is the maker, never a product brand; musterd and batond are independent products (a house of brands); and the competitive line is coordination-of-independent-actors, not intra-task orchestration — humans are the maximally separable actor no monolith can absorb.
- [Recorded, not routed](recorded-not-routed.md) — A correction can be durably recorded, dated, and correct — and still fail, because the surface a reader consults at the moment of action was never updated, and the existence of the record is exactly what lets everyone stop worrying about it.
- [Research corpus — what we have measured, and where it lives](research-corpus.md) — Every number in findings 001–008 comes from two directories on one laptop, none of it committed; this page is the map of what exists, what produces it, and what is designed but not built.
- [Running the gates locally](running-the-gates.md) — CI's `gates` job is install → build → typecheck → lint → coverage → format:check, in that order — running a subset and calling it green is the classic red-CI cause, and grepping a gate's output instead of trusting its exit code has lied at least once.
- [Seat identity — leaks, clobbers, and recovery](seat-identity.md) — An identity swap has no failure mode — the seat resolves, tools work, you are just someone else — so diagnose with `claude mcp get musterd` (the adapter's env), never by reading `binding.json`, which can be correct while the adapter lies.
- [Seat liveness — the ladder measures musterd silence](seat-liveness.md) — `lastActivityAt` ticks only on musterd MCP calls, so the ADR 164 ladder demotes exactly the seats heads-down on real work — builds, browser runs, and filesystem sweeps are all invisible to it.
- [The shared daemon on :4849](shared-daemon.md) — The dogfood daemon auto-refreshes itself on merge — never hand nick a `service refresh` chore; read `~/.musterd/autorefresh/refresh.log` instead, and know the three refresh traps before touching it.
- [Shipping a PR](shipping-a-pr.md) — One enforced git loop (ADR 106): branch from fresh origin/main → PR → `gh pr merge --squash --auto --delete-branch` → sync by rebase + `--force-with-lease`, never merge — plus the two traps that stall or pollute it.
- [Probing with a temp daemon](temp-daemon-probe.md) — Run probes against a throwaway daemon on its own DB and port — never against the shared daemon on :4849, and never via `musterd team create` from an unguarded shell.
- [Per-package vitest configs](vitest-package-configs.md) — A package-local vitest run inherits NOTHING from the root config — each standalone package must re-declare whatever the root was giving it.
- [Wake leases](wake-leases.md) — A wake lease is discharged by the seat REPORTING the wake — not by answering it — so `lease_expired` means the wake never landed, never "nobody answered".
- [Web performance — the /live arc, the gate, the public site, the measurement traps](web-performance.md) — What the byte gate covers, what it does not (page height, unlisted routes), and the traps that produce confident wrong numbers — the 2026-07 /live arc took Lighthouse 49 → 85 (transfer 1077 → 381 KB, DOM 4461 → 1564) and its ranked backlog is EXHAUSTED — the numbers live in docs/perf/web-live-baseline.md, and `pnpm perf:check` (ADR 151) gates the budgets in CI.
